egress.terms: 75 GB free every month, then EUR 0.01/GB (= EUR 10/TB) for all classes. No free-egress exemption for Glacier.

tooling: AWS CLI, rclone, all S3 SDKs
chaining: Archive leg only — objects must be restored to Standard Multi-AZ before download.
limits_note: `retention-clamped` + restore path: objects are listed but not downloadable until restored; restore target is Standard Multi-AZ only (lifecycle rules are top-down, so you cannot restore Glacier -> One Zone); restore start takes minutes to 24 h for objects over 1 MB; default restore window is 1 day and the object is billed at Standard Multi-AZ while restored. Also: "a billable unit started is due, so 1KB for 1 second on Object Storage is billed 1 GB hour".
reliability_note: Hosted in the DC4 fallout shelter, 25 m underground — high physical durability, deliberately slow retrieval path.

evidence.proved: Glacier EUR 0.0000035/GB/hour = EUR 0.00254/GB/month; Standard Multi-AZ EUR 0.01606/GB/month; Standard One Zone EUR 0.00803/GB/month; Egress "75GB free every month then EUR 0.01/GB /MONTH"
restore only Glacier -> Standard Multi-AZ; 750 GB free for 90 days on new accounts (trial, not steady-state)
restore Days=NUM, default 1 day, minutes-to-24h to start for objects >1 MB

price_per_tb_month: $2.85/TB at both 5 TB and 20 TB (EUR 2.54 = $2.85), plus EUR 10/TB on anything actually read out.
